package.name: CAM Addon
package.description: Makes CAM in FreeCAD easier - from the part to the finished NC program. Describe your machine or create one ready-made, manage tools with holders, cutting data and magazines, machine parts with assistants for 2.5D, 3D, 4-axis and 5-axis milling, check travel limits, collisions and material removal on the machine, and write programs for LinuxCNC, Siemens, Fanuc, Haas, Mach and Heidenhain.
